headline: NYM @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 4.79 at ARI 4.88, with a projected total of 9.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: NYM moved -0.15 runs while ARI moved +0.25, changing the projected margin by -0.40 runs. NRFI probability rose +5.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Huascar Brazobán has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Ildemaro Vargas, Lourdes Gurriel Jr., Juan Soto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
